Class GraphModelSeat

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.GraphModelSeat
final class GraphModelSeat extends Object
The seat is one user's graph model and the options chosen with it. A word alone is the engine. A kept seat also holds the options. The think file stores the seat under that user.

  • Method Details

    • parse

      static GraphModelSeat parse(Object value)
      The method reads one yaml value. A string is the engine word and the options are not kept. A map with an option key keeps the options. A null value returns null.
      Parameters:
      value - The value is the stored yaml node.
      Returns:
      The return value is the seat, or null.

    • yamlValue

      Object yamlValue()
      The method writes the seat for the think file. A seat that has not kept options writes the engine word. A kept seat writes the engine and the options. An empty engine returns null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the yaml node, or null.

    • kept

      boolean kept()
      The method reports whether the options were stored.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when the options are kept.

    • engine

      String engine()
      The method returns the engine word.
      Returns:
      The return value is the trimmed word, or empty.

    • engine

      void engine(String word)
      The method stores the engine word. The options stay as they are.
      Parameters:
      word - The word is the engine. A null word stores empty.

    • keepGrok

      void keepGrok(String modelId, String effortWord, boolean send, boolean streamOn, boolean burnerOn, double temp, int max, boolean thinking)
      The method stores the Grok options and marks them kept.
      Parameters:
      modelId - The model id normalizes the effort.
      effortWord - The effort is the level text.
      send - The flag sends the effort.
      streamOn - The flag streams the call.
      burnerOn - The flag allows a burner hop.
      temp - The value is the temperature.
      max - The value is the completion cap.
      thinking - The flag is the Grok thinking checkbox.

    • keepOllama

      void keepOllama(boolean on, String level)
      The method stores the Ollama thinking options and marks them kept.
      Parameters:
      on - The flag is the Ollama thinking checkbox.
      level - The level is the effort text.

    • keepPool

      void keepPool(boolean on)
      The method stores the pool thinking flag and marks the options kept.
      Parameters:
      on - The flag is the pool thinking checkbox.

    • keepLlama

      void keepLlama(boolean tempPresent, double temp, boolean maxPresent, int max)
      The method stores the llama temperature and cap and marks the options kept.
      Parameters:
      tempPresent - The flag is true when a temperature was stored.
      temp - The value is the temperature.
      maxPresent - The flag is true when a cap was stored.
      max - The value is the cap.

    • callOptions

      GrokCallOptions callOptions(boolean thinking)
      The method builds the DSL call options for a kept Grok engine. Any other engine returns null. A seat that has not kept options returns null. Thinking on forces the stream on. A stored stream also turns the stream on.
      Parameters:
      thinking - The flag is true when the thinking ear is open.
      Returns:
      The return value is the call options, or null.
